summary: A 40 by 60 ft frame tent covers 2,400 sq ft. Rental listings give up to 192 seated at 24 round tables, or 144 when a quarter of the space goes to a dance floor, stage, buffet or bar; one lists 200 at banquet rounds and 400 theater style. Legs come 8, 10 or 12 ft tall, and one listing gives 18 ft to the top. Frame tents have no center poles.
